facts.text: Andaz Xintiandi, Shanghai was the first hotel of the Andaz brand to launch in Asia.
facts.excerpt: Andaz Xintiandi, Shanghai was the first hotel of the Andaz brand to launch in Asia

facts.text: The Andaz name means 'personal style' in Hindi.
facts.excerpt: The Andaz name—“personal style” in Hindi

facts.text: All rooms are non-smoking and feature contemporary decor and mood lighting.
facts.excerpt: All 306 rooms are non-smoking and feature contemporary décor and mood lighting.

facts.text: The King Bed with Xintiandi View room offers views of Xintiandi, with a separate sitting area.
facts.excerpt: Savour the views of Xintiandi from the serenity of your spacious room featuring a plush king bed, a separate sitting area and a modern bathroom.

facts.text: Rooms have heated floors in the bathroom.
facts.excerpt: Heated floor in bathroom

facts.text: Rooms have an iPad-based guestroom solution.
facts.excerpt: iPad-based guestroom solution

facts.text: The Andaz Loft King is a residential-like bi-level suite with a separate lounge and a Typhoon shower.
facts.excerpt: Settle into this luxurious residential-like bi-level suite featuring a king bed, separate lounge and an expansive modern bathroom with a Typhoon shower.

facts.text: The Andaz XL Suite is a bi-level suite highlighting traditional craftsmanship with modern touches, with a separate lounge and an intimate dining area.
facts.excerpt: This large bi-level suite highlights traditional craftsmanship with modern touches, featuring a king bed, separate lounge and an intimate dining area.

facts.text: The Penthouse Skyview suite looks down on Xintiandi and Huai Hai Road and has a full kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a unique view of Xintiandi and Huai Hai Road below from the luxurious suite featuring high ceilings, oversized windows, a separate bedroom with a king bed, an expansive bathroom, a full kitchen

facts.text: The Penthouse Retreat is a spa suite with an oversized bathtub and a massage table for in-room spa treatments.
facts.excerpt: Escape to this spa suite featuring an oversized bathtub and massage table for in-room spa treatments

facts.text: The bi-level Penthouse Garden suite has a karaoke entertainment center and a full kitchen.
facts.excerpt: The bi-level Penthouse Garden suite is an entertainer’s dream featuring high ceilings, a dining room for eight, a Karaoke Entertainment Center and a full kitchen.

facts.text: The Penthouse Garden suite has a rooftop garden with sun beds and a hot tub.
facts.excerpt: Rooftop garden with sun beds and a hot tub

facts.text: The Penthouse Garden suite's separate dining room can host up to 10 guests.
facts.excerpt: Separate dining room can host up to 10 guests

facts.text: The Andaz Suite has a private office with a large desk.
facts.excerpt: Unique to this suite is the private office with a large desk and great views.

facts.text: Bleu Bar, designed by the Japanese design firm Tofu Inc., has seats inside and on a terrace.
facts.excerpt: Designed by renowned Japanese design firm Tofu Inc., the intimate space—22 seats inside and 25 seats on the terrace

facts.text: 88 Sushi Bento Bar is a Japanese restaurant tucked in a steel cocoon above the Andaz Lounge.
facts.excerpt: The beautiful Japanese restaurant 88 Sushi Bento Bar is tucked in the stunning steel cocoon above Andaz Lounge.

facts.text: 88 Sushi Bento Bar was designed by Tofu Inc. with lead designer Yoshifumi Tanaka.
facts.excerpt: Designed by internationally renowned Japanese design firm Tofu Inc., with lead designer Yoshifumi Tanaka

facts.text: Kitchen Studios is rooted in Shanghai style and brings together international cuisines.
facts.excerpt: Rooted in the refined charm of Shanghai style and bringing together international cuisines

facts.text: The Andaz Lounge signature drink is a Kir Royal.
facts.excerpt: The signature drink is a Kir Royal, made with the original crème de cassis liqueur from France.
